title: Affordable meals
question: Return name and avg_cost for restaurants costing at most $12. Sort by avg_cost from lowest to highest.
sql: SELECT name, avg_cost FROM restaurants WHERE avg_cost <= 12 ORDER BY avg_cost;

title: Top three ratings
question: Return name and rating for the three highest-rated restaurants. Sort by rating from highest to lowest.
sql: SELECT name, rating FROM restaurants ORDER BY rating DESC LIMIT 3;

title: Close and highly rated
question: Return name, rating, and distance_miles for restaurants within 1.5 miles with a rating of at least 4.5. Sort by distance_miles.
sql: SELECT name, rating, distance_miles FROM restaurants WHERE distance_miles <= 1.5 AND rating >= 4.5 ORDER BY distance_miles;

title: Restaurants per cuisine
question: Return cuisine and COUNT(*) AS restaurant_count for each cuisine. Sort by restaurant_count descending, then cuisine alphabetically.
sql: SELECT cuisine, COUNT(*) AS restaurant_count FROM restaurants GROUP BY cuisine ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC, cuisine;

title: Average meal cost
question: Return cuisine and AVG(avg_cost) AS average_cost for each cuisine. Sort by cuisine alphabetically.
sql: SELECT cuisine, AVG(avg_cost) AS average_cost FROM restaurants GROUP BY cuisine ORDER BY cuisine;
